description: Submit a single-use HMAC execution_ticket from matchmake_agent_crew to record empirical downstream task completion or failure (+0.05 clean delivery / -0.20 timeout or schema failure on Byte-2 Guarantee grade). Use after invoking a matched agent to close the quality feedback loop.

agent_id.description: Target agent_id that executed the downstream call.

execution_ticket.description: Single-use HMAC execution_ticket issued by matchmake_agent_crew.

observed_latency_ms.description: Optional caller-observed round-trip execution latency in milliseconds.

outcome_success.description: True if the downstream agent fulfilled its schema contract cleanly; false on timeout, HTTP error, or malformed output.

name: report_execution_outcome

ticket_valid.description: True when the single-use HMAC ticket passed verification and updated telemetry.

title: Report Post-Handshake Execution Outcome
